design_philosophy.vision: Awwwards-level ultra-premium dark nightlife discovery PWA. High-tension typography, tactile physical depth, kinetic micro-interactions, silky smooth 60fps mobile scroll performance.
design_philosophy.core_archetype: Electric & Neon / Tactical Minimalism (Deep void background #0A0A0C with hyper-precise magenta #FF0055 & cyan #00F0FF accents)
mobile_first_principles: Zero-jank 60fps scrolling using pure GPU hardware acceleration (will-change, opacity, transform only)
Thumb-zone friendly tap targets (minimum 48px height for primary buttons)
Sticky condensing header with glassmorphism backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/70 z-50
Tactile haptic-feeling feedback with scale-95 active tap states
Dynamic glass depth: subtle 1px border gradients, inner glow reflections, and noise overlays

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-none text-white
hierarchy.h2_section: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-white
hierarchy.h3_card_title: text-lg sm:text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white line-clamp-1
hierarchy.subtitle: text-sm sm:text-base text-zinc-400 font-normal leading-relaxed
hierarchy.caption: text-xs text-zinc-500 font-medium

motion_spec.prefers_reduced_motion: Wrap custom animations with window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches check or set initial={false} when enabled.

mobile_specifics.card_rhythm: Single-column full width layout on mobile (px-4 py-3 spacing between cards)
mobile_specifics.header_behavior: Sticky glass header with condensed search input on scroll down
mobile_specifics.thumb_zone: CTA buttons ('Voy' / 'Me Interesa') positioned at bottom of EventCard with min 48px height for effortless tap
mobile_specifics.bottom_nav: Fixed frosted bottom nav bar with active indicator magenta light-bar dot

key_elements: City Pill Switcher with cyan ring glow and live pulsing location ping dot
Display title '¿Dónde está la noche?' using Unbounded font font-black
Interactive pill filters (Popular, Techno, Reggaeton, VIP) with horizontal drag-scroll
Glass search bar with instant filter filtering

Blue and green lasers illuminate a dark concert venue
Group of people in front of energetic stage with neon lights

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards, tabs) MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 2-color neon dark palette (#FF0055 magenta and #00F0FF cyan over #0A0A0C background).
Maintain the 3-block TONIGHT structure ('Esta noche', 'Tu gente', 'Próximamente').
Optimize all framer-motion props to rely solely on opacity and scale/translate transform properties for zero frame drops.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid tags.
Ensure header/overlays NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds.
